headline: AppFolio's growth accelerates, guidance raised
summary_short: AppFolio's Q2 2026 revenue rose 19.3% y/y to $281.1M, with GAAP operating margin expanding to 18.8% from 17.2% and net income up 15.5% y/y to $41.5M; the company raised full-year revenue and operating-margin guidance.
summary_long: Revenue grew 19.3% y/y to $281.1M; total units under management rose 8% y/y to 9.6 million. GAAP operating income rose 30.8% to $53.0M (18.8% margin, up from 17.2%), as total operating expenses grew 17.0% y/y, slower than revenue. Non-GAAP operating income rose 24% to $76.2M (27.1% margin). Net income rose 15.5% y/y to $41.5M ($1.17 diluted EPS; $1.71 non-GAAP), with the effective tax rate rising to 23.6% from 14.3%. Operating cash flow was $87.6M (31.2% of revenue) versus $52.6M a year ago. Cash rose to $217.4M from $107.0M at year-end on investment maturities. AppFolio raised full-year 2026 guidance: revenue to $1.117-$1.127B and non-GAAP operating margin to 26.5%-28.0%.

Total costs and operating expenses grew 17.0% y/y, slower than revenue's 19.3% growth even though cost of revenue itself grew faster (+22.4%); the net effect is the disclosed operating-margin expansion to 18.8% from 17.2%.
